comparisons.sourceObservation: The bootstrap plan and separate approval record are the exact human-approved implementation authority.
comparisons.targetObservation: The self-hosted plan is marked superseded and reports lineage to the existing approval.
comparisons.disposition: Keep the bootstrap approval controlling; never infer approval from the derived plan instance.

comparisons.sourceObservation: The bootstrap Markdown predates the registered development capabilities and implemented JSON contracts.
comparisons.targetObservation: The self-hosted artifacts name bootstrap files as historical inputs and the receipt covers only this post-registration W080 event.
comparisons.disposition: Do not backdate receipts or attribute bootstrap authorship to a capability.

comparisons.sourceObservation: The compact bootstrap documents use human-authored Markdown headings to anticipate later contract fields.
comparisons.targetObservation: Canonical JSON instances now carry typed fields; Markdown and DOT files are lossy deterministic projections.
comparisons.disposition: Treat JSON as canonical and projections as regenerable review aids.

comparisons.sourceObservation: The bootstrap design proposed the package boundaries and inward dependency rules.
comparisons.targetObservation: The self-hosted design declares all 18 current source projects, packages, and their direct Program Kit references.
comparisons.disposition: Conformance compares the committed dependency graph with current project references.

comparisons.sourceObservation: The approved bootstrap plan contains the full W000 through W090 implementation sequence.
comparisons.targetObservation: The separate self-hosted plan represents only W080 and remains non-authoritative; earlier work stays historical and W090 remains governed by the bootstrap plan.
comparisons.disposition: Do not duplicate completed historical work or create a competing approval surface.

comparisons.sourceObservation: W080 requires deterministic Markdown and dependency, forbidden-reference, and Version Map graphs.
comparisons.targetObservation: Committed projections are fixed and checked by bootstrap comparison conformance tests; the public CLI render and generic graph descriptors still have no registered backend.
comparisons.disposition: Deliver and verify W080 projections without changing production runtime outside the approved edit boundary; any CLI backend wiring requires a separately approved plan.

comparisons.sourceObservation: Historical bootstrap front matter still says awaiting-human-approval because those exact reviewed bytes are immutable.
comparisons.targetObservation: The separate exact approval record records the later approved decision and remains active.
comparisons.disposition: Preserve the source bytes and use the approval record, not rewritten front matter, as decision evidence.
